import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    cnt = {}
    for _ in range(n):
        x = int(next(it))
        cnt[x] = cnt.get(x, 0) + 1
    w = int(next(it))
    ans = 0
    for start in range(1, 1001):
        cur = 0
        for key, val in cnt.items():
            if start <= key <= start + w:
                cur += val
        if cur > ans:
            ans = cur
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
